information: Online Registration closes on 6th February at 23:59 IST. Your registration will only be confirmed after you have made your payment online. For online registration it is mandotry to register online on WCA and make the payment. *On the spot Registration* will be available from 8:00 to 9:00 AM on day of the competition at the venue. Please check the[ Registration Procedure and Accomodation tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeChallengeQuark2018#3777-registration-procedure-and-accomodation) for detailed instructions. Check the [Schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeChallengeQuark2018#3778-schedule) for the competition schedule and Cutoffs&Timelimits. **Please carry an ID proof with you on day of the event.**
